dedupe_keys.name: national railway network nrwn geobase series canada

description: The National Railway Network (NRWN) is the GeoBase series dataset from Natural Resources Canada giving the geometry and attributes of Canada's railway network. Its features are Track Segments, Railway Crossings, Railway Stations, Marker Posts, Junctions and Railway Structures. Attributes cover track classification and name, the operator, user and owner of the track, subdivision, junction type, crossing type and warning system, the Transport Canada crossing identifier, station name, type and users, and structure type such as bridges and tunnels. Coverage is national; a copy on ArcGIS Online describes about 48,000 km of track and over 23,000 grade crossings in eleven provincial and territorial datasets. The data are available to download as shapefile and KMZ, with PDF documentation and a WMS service, free under the Open Government Licence - Canada; the portal record was last modified in May 2021. Caveats: the portal record has not been modified since 2021, so recent track changes may be missing. It provides the rail topology, grade crossings and bridge and tunnel structures needed for rail network flow, level crossing risk, hazard exposure and interdependency analysis with roads. It complements the National Road Network (NRN) and is related to the Statistics Canada railway transport survey tables.
